name: compliance-cert-showcase
title: Compliance Cert Showcase
description: A trust badge showcase presenting verified audit credentials, security seals, and data compliance marks.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Industrial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Compliance Cert Showcase Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
